claims.claim: Thirty Australian Defence Force and Defence civilian members deployed to Indonesia for Exercise Trident Resolve from 21 to 25 September 2026 under the ADMM-Plus framework, focused on humanitarian assistance and disaster relief, with Australia co-chairing the cybersecurity Experts Working Group alongside Cambodia.
claims.episode_span: A contingent of 30 Australian Defence Force and Defence civilian members has deployed to Indonesia for Exercise Trident Resolve, running from 21 to 25 September 2026.
claims.source_title: Australia joins ASEAN-led Exercise Trident Resolve in Indonesia
claims.supporting_quote: A contingent of 30 Australian Defence Force and Defence civilian members have deployed to Indonesia for Exercise Trident Resolve from 21 to 25 September 2026. Conducted under the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Defence Ministers’ Meeting Plus (ADMM-Plus) framework, the exercise focuses on sharing experience and best practices in humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) operations. Australia is co-chairing the cybersecurity Experts Working Group alongside Cambodia.
